messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled staged rollout 20% -> v1.14.0 (split: 10% EU, 10% NA). Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://go/release/1.14.0 :sparkles:

maya_releng: starting heatup now. will monitor ingress and model-pool metrics. tagging @drew_sre for EU watch.

drew_sre: EU 10% cohort getting intermittent 504s from model pool after ~90s. tail traces show connection reset during long-running prompts.

liam_infra: flagged: connection pooling change in runtime v1.14.0 might be closing idle sockets too aggressively. some shard proxies report ERR_CONN_RESET. autoscale unaffected.

chelsea_pm: customer impact? any logged incidents?

drew_sre: visible impact ~0.2% elevated 504s for EU cohort. recommending we PAUSE EU expansion and pin NA to continue.

maya_releng: propose: (1) STOP EU expansion and pin at 10%, (2) route EU canary to fallback variant v1.13.11-connstable, (3) continue NA ramp to 30% if NA stable for 10m.

ops_lead: vote: stop(eu)/go(na if metrics OK). Executing pin for EU. @deploy-bot freeze-eu 10%. :ballot_box_with_check:

deploy-bot: Action taken at 1758120456: traffic.freeze applied for cohort=eu canary (10%). Lock: https://go/deploy/locks/1758120456

liam_infra: ready to run fallback route: `route-cohort --cohort eu --to v1.13.11-connstable --drain=30s` awaiting approval.

drew_sre: approve fallback. after routing, monitor 15m for 504 reduction and any regressions.

maya_releng: approved. @deploy-bot execute liam_infra's route and post results here. I'll update release notes with regression note and open a follow-up ticket if persists.

deploy-bot: Executing route change: draining EU canary 10% then attaching to v1.13.11-connstable. Monitoring p95, 5xx rate, and connection resets. ETA ~90s.

ops_lead: creating incident INC-2025-0011 for tracking. scheduling 25m post-check. Tagging @oncall and @infra.

maya_releng: post-change: EU 504s returned to baseline within 4m. No customer escalations. Keeping rollout pinned in EU while we patch connection pooling in staging. NA ramp continues as planned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
